surface_name: supabase-js auth client, onAuthStateChange and session lock
title: Supabase queries hang forever after awaiting a Supabase call inside onAuthStateChange
symptoms: The next supabase.from(...) or getSession() anywhere in the app never resolves, with no error
Acquiring an exclusive Navigator LockManager lock immediately failed
Hang shows up only after login, a tab refocus, or a token refresh
cause: Older auth clients held a session lock while running onAuthStateChange callbacks, so awaiting another Supabase call inside the callback waited on the same lock. Version 2.107.0 removed the navigator.locks mutex.
fix: Upgrade to supabase-js 2.107.0 or later. On older versions keep the callback synchronous and defer any Supabase call with setTimeout. Even on new versions, never call refreshSession from a TOKEN_REFRESHED handler.
affected: @supabase/supabase-js 2.x before 2.107.0 (released 2026-06-02); gotrue-js 2.62.0 and later in that range
